name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Between Blackwood and Butler, one goes with Envy and the other with Greed.
Either Blackwood goes with Chef, or Envy goes with Maid — but not both.
Either Crane goes with Greed, or Secrecy goes with Maid — but not both.
Governess goes with none of Crane, Pierce, or Secrecy.
Either Ashford goes with Envy or Pierce goes with Blackmail.
Greed does not go with Blackwood if and only if Butler goes with Blackmail.
Secrecy goes with exactly one of Ashford, Blackwood, or Chef.

chain: Start by assuming Secrecy goes with Butler.
Butler goes with Secrecy, so Envy can't go with Butler.
Butler goes with Secrecy, so Greed can't go with Butler.
…but now the clue “Between Blackwood and Butler, one goes with Envy and the other with Greed” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Secrecy does not go with Butler.
